Saratoga NY Bred Yearling Sale, August 16-17, 2026


Thank you for nominating your yearling(s) to the Fasig-Tipton 2026 Selected Yearling Sales. Physical inspections begin in mid-March following our initial pedigree evaluation process. Below is our tentative physical inspection schedule for the upcoming spring. It may become necessary to adjust our inspection schedule from time to time so please feel free to call and inquire at any time. The location farm included on your nomination form will be contacted by telephone approximately three – five days prior to our inspection visit to schedule the appointment.

If the location of your yearling(s) has changed from your original nomination, please notify Lindsey Crum (lcrum@fasigtipton.com) or Abby Lauer (alauer@fasigtipton.com) or call (859) 255-1555 as soon as possible.

2026 TENTATIVE INSPECTION SCHEDULE*
